summary: Frontend-only iteration 18 verification passed all three requested visual fixes on the public URL. After skipping boot, the six ΣIRIUS letters completed with opacity 1, identity transforms and no overlap; the title remained unsliced and unshifted after a further 10.5-second observation. Left/right hand matrix signs, 5vh placement, matte filters and 0.92 opacity matched the specification, and the screenshot showed natural inward-facing thumbs with diffuse, non-glossy skin. The command bar also accepted and submitted a command successfully.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested title, hand orientation/position, matte-skin, and command-bar checks passed

seed_data_creation: No backend data created. Browser localStorage was populated with the requested Testeur/Paris profile, current briefing date, PWA dismissal timestamp, installed flag and hands-enabled flag; sessionStorage suppressed the WAHOU sequence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 1920x1080, final title rects were contiguous with 0 px overlap, title animation-name was 'goldSheen, goldPulse', clip-path was none, and all letter transforms were identity both after entrance and 10.5 seconds later. Left matrix a=0.978572 and right matrix a=-0.982683; both computed bottom=54px, filter included brightness(0.85) saturate(0.82), opacity=0.92, and the 1024px hand asset loaded. The command 'quelle heure est-il' cleared the input and returned a spoken-time subtitle. No page errors, visible DOM errors, or unexpected console errors occurred; six bounded ws://localhost:8765 failures were the known public-preview behavior unrelated to these visual changes.
rca_of_the_issue: The implemented fixes directly address the reported causes: .sirius-title now runs only goldSheen and goldPulse while letterIn settles to transform:none; HoloScene applies no horizontal mirror to the left hand and scaleX(-1) to the right; .holo-hand computes from bottom:5vh with brightness(0.85), saturate(0.82), and opacity:0.92. Runtime and screenshot verification confirmed the intended results.
